title: Repositorio de teatro breve del Siglo de Oro (TBSO)
notes: Personal research repository of short Golden Age plays (entremeses) by David Merino Recalde, as plain text and XML-TEI, based on printed editions such as Cotarelo y Mori (1911). The collection is not closed and only some texts have TEI. Released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
